abilities.name: Vampiric Touch
abilities.description: Mal'Ganis heals for 45% of damage dealt to enemy Heroes and 10% of damage dealt to non-Heroes.; trait

fields.notes: Grants Mal'Ganis 10% base lifesteal against all units, which is increased by 35% against Heroes. Stacks additively with other sources of lifesteal.

abilities.name: Fel Claws
abilities.description: Violently slash in the chosen direction, dealing 66 damage to enemies. Reactivate to slash up to 2 more times. The third slash Stuns enemies for 0.75 seconds.; 8 / 0.5

fields.type: Spell Damage, Crowd control / Movement: Dash
fields.notes: 1) The last part of the first and second dashes' damage area is a half circle in front of Mal'Ganis. Cooldown starts immediately upon the first cast. The first 0.25 seconds of the third dash's Stun knocks the enemies up in the air. This effect is purely visual.

abilities.name: Necrotic Embrace
abilities.description: Desecrate the air, dealing 110 damage to nearby enemies and gaining 25 Armor for 3 seconds.

fields.notes: Does not stack with other positive Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

abilities.name: Night Rush
abilities.description: After 0.75 seconds, gain 50% Movement Speed for 2 seconds. While active, Mal'Ganis can move through enemy Heroes and put them to Sleep for 2.5 seconds.; 14 / 0.5

fields.props: Mobile channel, Movement Speed buff, Sleep
fields.notes: Night Rush can be reactivated after 0.5 seconds to end its effect early. Mal'Ganis can use Necrotic Embrace during Night Rush without breaking the channel. Using any other ability interrupts Night Rush immediately. Mal'Ganis cannot use Basic Attacks during Night Rush. Sleep counts as a Stun effect and interacts with all effects that interact with Stuns.

abilities.name: Carrion Swarm
abilities.description: After 1 second, disperse into an Invulnerable swarm of bats for 3 seconds, dealing 120 damage per second to enemies. Vampiric Touch heals for 75% of Carrion Swarm's damage to Heroes.; 100; 70; heroic

fields.notes: 1) Carrion Swarm's damage area consists of three cones in "opposite" directions that rotate every 0.0625s between three possible orientations. Regardless, enemies can only be damaged by the Ability once every 0.5 seconds. Interrupting the ability during its cast puts it on a 10 second cooldown. Mal'Ganis can move, but cannot use Abilities both while channeling and during Carrion Swarm. Carrion Swarm removes most negative effects from Mal'Ganis once the channel finishes and Mal'Ganis enters Stasis. Carrion Swarm sets the base lifesteal bonus to 75% against all enemies, which is against non-Heroic enemies reduced multiplicatively by 87.1%, resulting in 9.675% lifesteal when no other lifesteal effects are in place. Stacks additively with Vampiric Touch bonuses from Fueled by Torment and Vanquish the Weak as well as other sources of lifesteal.

abilities.name: Dark Conversion
abilities.description: Channel on an enemy Hero for 0.75 seconds, then swap Health percentages with the target over 3 seconds.; 60; 60; heroic

fields.props: Channeled cast (stationary), Damage over time, Heal over time
fields.notes: Interrupting the ability during its windup puts it on a 10 second cooldown. Cast is interrupted if the target moves at least 3 units past its maximum range. Despite being based on percentage of target's Health, Dark Conversion is not considered Percent Damage. Its damage can be affected by damage modifiers, such as Armor and Spell Power. Heal over time persists even in the case that the DoT is removed. Dark Conversion 's damage is not affected by the lifesteal from Vampiric Touch. If Mal'Ganis has a higher percentage of Health than the target enemy Hero, the ability will instead damage Mal'Ganis while healing the enemy Hero, and can even deal fatal damage to Mal'Ganis.

talents.name: Winged Guard
talents.description: Each time Necrotic Embrace hits an enemy Hero, gain 75 Physical Armor against the next enemy Hero Basic Attack. If Winged Guard has no charges, Mal'Ganis will gain 1 charge after 6 seconds.

fields.notes: Does not stack with itself or other positive Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

_raw_fields: Each time Necrotic Embrace hits an enemy Hero, gain 75 Physical Armor against the next enemy Hero Basic Attack. If Winged Guard has no charges, Mal'Ganis will gain 1 charge after 6 seconds.

talents.name: Vampiric Aura
talents.description: Mal'Ganis heals for 30% of Physical Damage dealt, and nearby allied Heroes heal for 15% of Physical Damage dealt.

fields.notes: Stacks additively with Vampiric Touch and other lifesteal effects.

_raw_fields: Mal'Ganis heals for 30% of Physical Damage dealt, and nearby allied Heroes heal for 15% of Physical Damage dealt.

talents.name: Time to Feed
talents.description: Mal'Ganis heals for 70 when damaging a nearby enemy Hero. This can occur once every 6 seconds against each enemy Hero, but is also refreshed when they are slept by Night Rush.

fields.notes: Enemy Heroes damaged by Mal'Ganis must be within the radius to trigger Time to Feed.

_raw_fields: Mal'Ganis heals for 70 when damaging a nearby enemy Hero. This can occur once every 6 seconds against each enemy Hero, but is also refreshed when they are slept by Night Rush.

talents.name: Fueled by Torment
talents.description: While Necrotic Embrace is active, Mal'Ganis heals for 12 when damage is taken and Vampiric Touch converts 20% more Hero damage into healing.

fields.notes: Lifesteal bonus stacks additively with Vampiric Touch and other lifesteal effects.

_raw_fields: While Necrotic Embrace is active, Mal'Ganis heals for 12 when damage is taken and Vampiric Touch converts 20% more Hero damage into healing.

talents.name: Might of Sargeras
talents.description: Necrotic Embrace's Armor is increased to 50.
_raw_fields: Necrotic Embrace's Armor is increased to 50.

talents.name: Echo of Doom
talents.description: When Necrotic Embrace expires, it explodes again for 68 damage. For each enemy Hero hit, gain 5 Mana and reduce the cooldown of Necrotic Embrace by 0.75 seconds. Does not wake Sleeping targets.

fields.notes: Secondary explosion only deals damage and does not interact with talents affecting Necrotic Embrace. Does not draw tower aggro when damaging enemy Heroes under their Structures.

_raw_fields: When Necrotic Embrace expires, it explodes again for 68 damage. For each enemy Hero hit, gain 5 Mana and reduce the cooldown of Necrotic Embrace by 0.75 seconds. Does not wake Sleeping targets.

talents.name: Black Claws
talents.description: After Mal'Ganis hits an enemy Hero with Fel Claws, his next Basic Attack deals 60% more damage and reduces the Armor of enemy Heroes by 15 for 2 seconds.

fields.type: Offensive damage modifier / Defensive damage modifier
fields.notes: Attack Damage bonus does not stack with itself nor generate multiple charges. Armor reduction is applied after the damage is dealt. Basic Attack damage bonus stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Mal'Ganis's Basic Attack damage. Does not stack with itself or other negative Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

_raw_fields: After Mal'Ganis hits an enemy Hero with Fel Claws, his next Basic Attack deals 60% more damage and reduces the Armor of enemy Heroes by 15 for 2 seconds.

talents.name: Will of Tichondrius
talents.description: Each enemy Hero hit by the first 2 slashes of Fel Claws causes the final slash to steal 1% of maximum health from heroes, up to 4%. If at least 4 enemy Heroes are hit with the first 2 slashes of Fel Claws, then the final slash Stuns enemies for an additional 0.5 seconds.

fields.notes: Will of Tichondrius does not benefit from Vampiric Touch.

talents.name: Spreading Plague
talents.description: After casting Night Rush, deal 33 damage per second to nearby enemies. This effect lasts 5 seconds and Basic Attacks against Heroes refresh its duration. Does not wake Sleeping targets.

fields.notes: Does not draw tower aggro when damaging enemy Heroes under their Structures. Damage from Spreading Plague is affected by offensive damage modifiers unlike other burning rage effects. Spreading Plague pauses its duration while Mounted and during Carrion Swarm. Once these effects end, the effect continues with its remaining duration.

talents.description: Basic Attacks deal 200% bonus damage to Sleeping enemies. After Night Rush's Sleep ends, targets are Slowed by 30% for 3 seconds.
_raw_fields: Basic Attacks deal 200% bonus damage to Sleeping enemies. After Night Rush's Sleep ends, targets are Slowed by 30% for 3 seconds.

talents.name: Blood Rush
talents.description: When Mal'Ganis is healed by a Hero, he gains 1% Movement Speed for 6 seconds, up to 15%.

fields.notes: If Mal'Ganis receives healing while already at full Health, this talent does not trigger. Benefits from each instance of Mal'Ganis's lifesteal against Heroes, and also from healing received from Regeneration Globes, Healing Fountains, Biotic Emitters, Hearthing (but not the Heal over Time while within the Hall of Storms), and healing received from allied Heroes. Movement Speed bonus stacks additively with itself, but not with other Movement Speed buffs. Subsequent applications refresh the duration of existing stacks.

_raw_fields: When Mal'Ganis is healed by a Hero, he gains 1% Movement Speed for 6 seconds, up to 15%.

talents.name: Plague Bats
talents.description: Necrotic Embrace unleashes a wave of bats in front of Mal'Ganis, dealing 81 damage.
_raw_fields: Necrotic Embrace unleashes a wave of bats in front of Mal'Ganis, dealing 81 damage.

talents.name: Frenzied Assault
talents.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes with a higher Health percentage heal for an additional 50% of damage dealt. Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes with a lower Health percentage grant 35% Attack Speed for 3 seconds.

fields.notes: Lifesteal bonus stacks additively with baseline Vampiric Touch and other lifesteal effects.

_raw_fields: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes with a higher Health percentage heal for an additional 50% of damage dealt. Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes with a lower Health percentage grant 35% Attack Speed for 3 seconds.

talents.name: Blind as a Bat
talents.description: Cooldown 60 Active Activate to erupt with blind rage, removing the cooldown and Mana cost of Fel Claws, but losing all vision. Lasts 6 seconds. Enemy Heroes hit by the final slash of Fel Claws reduce the cooldown of this Ability by 4 seconds.

fields.notes: Fel Claws during Blind as a Bat follow the same three cast rotation as normal cast. Activating Blind as a Bat refreshes the cooldown of Fel Claws, making it instantly available once active recasts have been used. Fel Claws will not be put on cooldown if Blind as a Bat expires while awaiting the 2nd and 3rd activation of Fel Claws. During Blind as a Bat terrain and Mal'Ganis are visible, but you can't see any other units, abilities or damage pop-ups. Healing pop-ups, however, remain visible and can be used to infer hitting an enemy unit.

talents.description: Upon expiring, Carrion Swarm's bats seek nearby enemy Heroes, dealing 132 damage and Sleeping them for 2.5 seconds.

fields.notes: Does not draw tower aggro when damaging enemy Heroes under their Structures. Damage benefits from Carrion Swarm 's lifesteal bonus to Vampiric Touch. Sleep counts as a Stun effect and interacts with all effects that interact with Stuns.

fields.notes: The ability deals damage to the secondary targets regardless of whether the primary target or Mal'Ganis was the one that gained the DoT after Dark Conversion connected.
